title: Spatial Pattern and Environmental Drivers of Acid Phosphatase Activity in Europe.
summary: Back-propagation neural networks scaled laboratory-measured acid phosphatase activity from 126 European sites using environmental drivers; leave-one-out evaluation explained 58% of variability (RMSE 6.83 after excluding nine outliers) and identified climate/nutrient gradients. This is a model-based spatial ecological result, not causal attribution.
ai_technology: BPN and random forests infer spatial patterns from site measurements and environmental predictors.
